node.title: Rate-half FPC5 M=4,t=2 guarded split-locator payment
node.statement: For the official rate-half row, fix one admissible maximal M=4 sunflower source. Aggregate every non-planted FPC5 contributor touching exactly two full petals by one internal tangent, quotient/profile, or polynomial first owner. General first-layout domination proves that this one-layout payment plus at most four anchors is already global over source layouts. Every fixed exact-background guarded cell now has locator codimension at least ell-1, with equality on r=s and codimension at least ell for r>=s+1. Without selecting the uniquely reconstructed background set, the complete fixed-s residual is one joint locus where F splits on the source core and W_F has at least s background roots. At the sharp endpoint this is a typed projective flat with flat-wide common gcd one and no proper pure multiplicative quotient pullbacks. The remaining content is aggregate root-rich split-pair control, including possible partial-tail/rational/dihedral structures and internal-owner multiplicity.
node.attack_surface: prove an aggregate root-rich split-pair count for F split on the source core and its unique W_F with at least s background roots, without summing fixed-background flats
node.falsifier: a fixed official rate-half source whose internally first-owned two-full-petal contributors exceed every polynomial and legitimate profile column
